boundaryVintage: Permanent local planning areas (2016 census geography)
boundaryNote: The City's 22 local planning areas, whose boundaries the publisher says do not change. The 2016 custom census uses these same areas and includes Musqueam 2 reserve. This is not Vancouver CSD or Metro Vancouver; Stanley Park is outside these mapped local-area polygons.
coverageNote: 22 local planning areas in the City of Vancouver area, including the publisher's Musqueam 2 reserve coverage. Census measures are from 2016. Park polygons, rail and facility inventories have separate dated snapshots; libraries and community centres are older inventories, and later changes may be absent. Rail coverage stops at the municipal boundary. No CSD or CMA figures are substituted for neighbourhood data.

population.label: Population
population.note: 2016 Census total population in each local area; counts randomly rounded.
population.geographicScope: City of Vancouver's permanent local planning areas; not Metro Vancouver

households.label: Private households
households.note: 2016 Census private households by household size; 100% data, rounded counts.
households.geographicScope: City of Vancouver's permanent local planning areas; not Metro Vancouver

children.label: Children under 15
children.note: Published percentage aged 0–14 in the 2016 Census; 100% population data.
children.geographicScope: City of Vancouver's permanent local planning areas; not Metro Vancouver

householdSize.label: Average household size
householdSize.note: People per private household in the 2016 Census; collective dwellings excluded.
householdSize.geographicScope: City of Vancouver's permanent local planning areas; not Metro Vancouver

livingAlone.label: One-person households
livingAlone.note: One-person private households divided by all private households, 2016 Census; rounded 100% counts.
livingAlone.geographicScope: City of Vancouver's permanent local planning areas; not Metro Vancouver

apartments.label: Homes in apartment buildings
apartments.note: Occupied dwellings in buildings with fewer than five or five-plus storeys divided by all occupied private dwellings, 2016. Duplexes excluded.
apartments.geographicScope: City of Vancouver's permanent local planning areas; not Metro Vancouver

detached.label: Single-detached homes
detached.note: Single-detached occupied dwellings divided by all occupied private dwellings, 2016 Census.
detached.geographicScope: City of Vancouver's permanent local planning areas; not Metro Vancouver

duplex.label: Apartments or flats in duplexes
duplex.note: Occupied apartments or flats in duplexes divided by all occupied private dwellings, 2016 Census. The City cautions that classification changes may affect comparisons with earlier censuses.
duplex.geographicScope: City of Vancouver's permanent local planning areas; not Metro Vancouver

renters.label: Households renting
renters.note: Renter households divided by all private households by tenure, including band housing in the denominator; 2016 Census 25% sample, rounded counts.
renters.geographicScope: City of Vancouver's permanent local planning areas; not Metro Vancouver

tenantShelter.label: Median tenant shelter cost
tenantShelter.note: 2016 monthly shelter costs paid by existing tenants in non-farm, non-reserve dwellings, all sizes; includes utilities where applicable. 25% sample. Historical occupied-rental costs, not current asking rents.
tenantShelter.geographicScope: City of Vancouver's permanent local planning areas; not Metro Vancouver

transit.label: Commutes by public transit
transit.note: Among employed residents aged 15+ in private households with a usual workplace or no fixed workplace, 2016 Census 25% sample. Excludes working at home.
transit.geographicScope: City of Vancouver's permanent local planning areas; not Metro Vancouver

walkCycle.label: Commutes on foot or by bike
walkCycle.note: Walked plus cycled among the same 2016 employed-resident commuting denominator; excludes working at home. 25% sample.
walkCycle.geographicScope: City of Vancouver's permanent local planning areas; not Metro Vancouver

parkland.label: Mapped parkland
parkland.note: Share of the local-area polygon covered by the union of City park polygons. Overlaps counted once; includes mapped plazas and park sites, not all green space or tree canopy.
parkland.geographicScope: Original local-area and park polygons intersected in NAD83 / UTM zone 10N

parks.label: Park sites overlapping the area
parks.note: Distinct published park-site polygons with more than 1 m² inside the local area. A site spanning areas appears in each; includes small plazas and unnamed sites.
parks.geographicScope: City of Vancouver's permanent local planning areas; not Metro Vancouver

rail.label: Rail stations in or near the area
rail.note: Distinct named stations inside or within 800 m of the boundary, using one representative published point per station. Straight-line proximity, not a walk from a home or a service-frequency measure. City-only 2023 inventory excludes later openings and stations beyond the municipality.
rail.geographicScope: City of Vancouver's permanent local planning areas; not Metro Vancouver

libraries.label: Mapped public library branches
libraries.note: City library records assigned by the publisher's local-area field; Outreach Services excluded. Dataset modified in 2020, with a legacy July 2009 currency note; branches may have moved or changed. Verify current details before visiting.
libraries.geographicScope: Publisher's geo_local_area, derived from coordinates or address

communityCentres.label: Mapped community centres
communityCentres.note: City community-centre inventory records assigned by the publisher's local-area field, including Carnegie and other listed community-service centres. Approximate locations; 2020 snapshot, not current opening or program availability.
communityCentres.geographicScope: Publisher's geo_local_area, derived from coordinates or address

sections.heading: Housing
sections.text: In the 2016 Census, 36.8% of Arbutus Ridge's households rented their home. Apartment buildings accounted for 45.1% of occupied homes, single-detached houses for 38.1%, and apartments or flats in duplexes for 11.6%. These dwelling categories describe building form, not tenure or homes currently available.

sections.heading: Households and residents
sections.text: The 2016 profile counted 15,295 residents and 6,065 private households. Average household size was 2.4 people; 30.4% of households had one person, and 13.2% of residents were younger than 15. Among residents aged 15+ in the labour force with an applicable occupation, the two largest broad groups were sales and service occupations (20.1%) and management occupations (19.9%). These are residents' occupations, not a count of jobs located here; occupation data use the 25% census sample.

sections.heading: Parks and everyday facilities
sections.text: The park map dated 2026-09-28 places 9 park sites partly or wholly in this local area, covering 6.0% of its mapped area, including Arbutus Village Park, Carnarvon Park and Prince Of Wales Park. The separate 2020 inventories contain no library or community-centre record assigned to this area. Facility records describe mapped locations; opening hours, programming and subsequent relocations need a current check.

sections.heading: Getting around
sections.text: In 2016, 23.6% of commuting residents travelled by public transit and 8.0% walked or cycled; the denominator excludes people working at home. The City's 2023-02-22 inventory contains no rail station inside or within 800 m of this boundary. That boundary measure does not describe the walk from any particular home, bus access or service frequency.

sections.heading: Practical considerations
sections.text: Check the current bus route and travel time from the actual address; an empty rail list does not mean the area has no public transit. The median tenant shelter cost of $1,503 per month is a 2016 measure of costs paid by existing tenants in non-farm, non-reserve dwellings, including utilities where applicable and all dwelling sizes. Use current listings for a move-in budget.

These are residents' occupations, not a count of jobs located here; occupation data use the 25% census sample.

sections.heading: Parks and everyday facilities
sections.text: The park map dated 2026-09-28 places 9 park sites partly or wholly in this local area, covering 15.1% of its mapped area, including Almond Park, Hastings Mill Park and Jericho Beach Park. The separate 2020 facility inventories list West Point Grey Community Centre and West Point Grey Library here. Facility records describe mapped locations; opening hours, programming and subsequent relocations need a current check.

sections.heading: Getting around
sections.text: In 2016, 26.1% of commuting residents travelled by public transit and 17.6% walked or cycled; the denominator excludes people working at home. The City's 2023-02-22 inventory contains no rail station inside or within 800 m of this boundary. That boundary measure does not describe the walk from any particular home, bus access or service frequency.

sections.heading: Practical considerations
sections.text: Check the current bus route and travel time from the actual address; an empty rail list does not mean the area has no public transit. The median tenant shelter cost of $1,347 per month is a 2016 measure of costs paid by existing tenants in non-farm, non-reserve dwellings, including utilities where applicable and all dwelling sizes. Use current listings for a move-in budget.
